$comment: Files permitted to call chrome.runtime.sendMessage / chrome.tabs.sendMessage directly. Every other module must go through shared/transport.ts, background-rpc.ts or offscreen-coordinator.ts, which bound the round trip in shared/timeout.ts. A direct call is only acceptable when it is (a) wrapped in withDeadline, or (b) genuinely fire-and-forget (void + .catch). Adding a file here is a decision, not a formality. Checked by scripts/verify/check-rpc-deadlines.ts.

files.apps/extension-spectra/src/shared/timeou: owns withDeadline; contains no sendMessage itself
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/shared/transp: wraps sendSpectraRpcMessage and deliverSpectraTabRpcMessage in withDeadline; the runtime-release envelope at the end is fire-and-forget
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/background/ba: wraps the per-tab round trip in withDeadline; this is the closure every Background to Content call funnels through
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/background/of: wraps the offscreen round trip in withDeadline; document creation stays outside it on purpose
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/background/se: per-tab delivery wrapped in withDeadline and classified as an absent receiver on timeout; the two settings broadcasts are fire-and-forget
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/background/si: lean host configure wrapped in withDeadline; a deadline is classified as an absent host
heavy host settings wrapped in withDeadline; a deadline is classified as a missing receiver
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/shared/regist: route editor request wrapped in withDeadline
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/background/au: awaited event publish whose rejection is already handled; the store must not fail a committed write because a listener is gone
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/content/core/: raw document_start bootstrap transport; the caller owns the boundary and no response is required
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/content/input: raw site hotkey transport; the caller inspects the response for errors only
files.apps/extension-spectra/src/offscreen-rem: raw transport in the offscreen remote host, where the injected dependency is the transport
